name: Chorizo & chickpea soup
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 servings based on typical soup recipe volume (one 400g can tomatoes + 400g can chickpeas + 140g cabbage + 110g chorizo + stock produces ~4 adult main portions) and common BBC Good Food scaling for similar one-pan soups.
Total time estimated at 15 minutes from instructions (heating tomatoes ~3-4 min + chopping chorizo/cabbage ~5 min + simmering 6 min), assuming parallel prep.
Chicken stock classified as containing possible soy (many commercial cubes list it); left null as ambiguous without specific brand.
Crusty bread assumed to contain wheat gluten as standard; no gluten-free indication given.
No milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts or sesame in listed ingredients.
Chilli flakes, tinned tomatoes, chickpeas, savoy cabbage and chorizo introduce no listed allergens.
instructions:
step 1
Put a medium pan on the heat and tip in the tomatoes, followed by a can of water. While the tomatoes are heating, quickly chop the chorizo into chunky pieces (removing any skin) and shred the cabbage.

step 2
Pile the chorizo and cabbage into the pan with the chilli flakes and chickpeas, then crumble in the stock cube. Stir well, cover and leave to bubble over a high heat for 6 mins or until the cabbage is just tender. Ladle into bowls and eat with crusty or garlic bread.

ingredients.name: Tinned Tomatos
ingredients.assumptions: Canned tomatoes in tomato juice, drained weight approximated to full 400g can contents as per recipe usage

ingredients.name: Chorizo
ingredients.assumptions: Typical cured Spanish chorizo sausage, edible portion after removing skin

ingredients.name: Savoy Cabbage
ingredients.assumptions: Raw savoy cabbage, fully edible trimmed weight

ingredients.name: Chilli Flakes
ingredients.assumptions: Dry red chilli flakes; 'sprinkling' estimated at 1g total for the whole recipe based on typical usage in a one-pan soup

ingredients.name: Chickpeas
ingredients.assumptions: Drained weight from a standard 400g can of chickpeas in water (approx 60% of can weight is drained solids)

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: One standard chicken stock cube (approx 4-5g each); nutrients based on typical dehydrated bouillon cube

ingredients.name: Crusty Bread
ingredients.assumptions: Crusty bread to serve; estimated at 50g per serving (one medium slice or small roll equivalent) as the recipe implies serving accompaniment, not a fixed ingredient quantity
